the first instant they disagree about, 2026-09-04T09:00:00Z, sample 140.00
  pooled    [67.50, 152.50]  centre 110.00, scale 14.17, breaching false
  envelope  [97.00, 130.00]  breaching true, from
    offset 24h   [97.00, 103.00]  centre 100.00, scale 1.00
    offset 48h   [130.00, 130.00]  centre 130.00, scale 0.00
    offset 72h   [97.00, 103.00]  centre 100.00, scale 1.00

Pooling spreads one unusual day across the scale, which widens the band
far enough to swallow the spike. The envelope keeps the day in its own
band, so the spike is still outside all three. This is one fixture and
one shape of history, so it is evidence and not a decision: it says the
two forms differ on the case seasonality exists for, which is more than
was known before there was a backtest to run them through.
